Arman: Concordance sent a perf ask: sustained 400 qps per region (us-west-2 primary, us-east-1 DR), avg ~350 tokens, max 512. Requirement: p95 < 120ms AFTER auth. They want Dedicated and will enable KMS + audit logs. Can we schedule a bench next week?

Leah: Confirm steady-state windows (30m) with a few 5s microbursts, correct? Any chat context or single-turn?

Arman: Correct: 30m holds, ~10 microbursts of 5s scattered. Single-turn generation; many requests share a 64-token header (prefix reuse).

Rae: Plan sketch: baseline model rwd-open-7b q8_256, infra 2 active A10GX-equivalents + 1 spare per region (3 nodes/region). Run pattern: warmup -> ramp 0->400 qps over 5m -> hold 30m -> microbursts injected. Capture p50/p95/p99, cold-starts, tokens/sec, GPU util, error rates.

Rae: Lightweight load example (k6):
````
k6 run --vus 400 --duration 40m bench.js --env MODEL=rwd-open-7b --env REGION=us-west-2
````
Sample client log line: 
[2026-04-02T16:12:05Z] req=ff12 lat_ms=84 status=200 tokens_out=342

Leah: KMS note: managed KMS in-region ~+4-6ms. Customer-KMS over DirectConnect/VPC can add +10-25ms. Concordance insists p95 after auth <120ms so we must include KMS in-path during run.

ops-bot: Tentative slot available Tue 2026-04-07 09:00 PT; 48h confirmation required to reserve nodes.

Arman: Please tentatively reserve. Pricing ask: Concordance wants committed monthly quote for Dedicated + optional VPC deployment with 99.9% SLA. Can we ballpark?

pricing-bot: Ballpark: 3 nodes/region (6 nodes total) at A10GX-equiv -> rough baseline X/hr per node -> ~6*X/hr. Monthly committed (12mo) approx Z/month after standard enterprise discount. VPC/peering adds one-time setup + recurring networking fee (est +P%). Exact requires SKU list and expected monthly sustained hours.

Rae: Deliverables we'll produce: 1) short perf report (latency percentiles and throughput curve), 2) cost comparison: hosted-dedicated vs private-VPC, 3) runbook + commands, 4) short video of tail latency, 5) security questionnaire answers including audit-log retention.

Leah: Ops/security blocker: customer demands Dedicated inside their VPC for compliance; that increases lead time (~2-3 weeks) and may affect latency. Recommend running both hosted-dedicated and a quick VPC smoke to show delta.

Arman: I'll confirm schedule with Concordance and return with their preferred slot. Rae please draft the runbook and include tokens/sec estimate for pricing. Thanks :thumbsup:
